messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rates detected on inference-gateway-prod (us-east-1). 5xx and 429s rising since ~9:03 UTC. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/errs/inference-gateway. PD: PD-7890.

rebecca: i'm oncall. seeing surge in 429 then gateway 503s. paging josh/priya. starting timeline capture.

josh: joining. throwing up quick smoke tests. any recent infra deploys or quota changes?

priya: there was an automated rollout of `quota-service@release-1.12` 12m ago via infra-cd. it included a new aggregator that *reinterprets* client-level rate headers. could be related.

emily: logged a bunch of client errors from enterprise customers hitting streaming endpoints; several show repeated reconnects. impact estimate: ~6 customers with >10% failure rate in last 10m.

rebecca: ok mitigation plan: 1) pause quota-service rollout, 2) relax gateway rate-limiter thresholds to reduce 429 propagation, 3) enable direct bypass route for top-ten customers, 4) status page update.

josh: pausing rollout: `infra-cd pause deploy quota-service release-1.12` -> accepted.

devops-bot: Action: deployment pause submitted by josh at 2034600062. JobID: job-8892.

priya: relaxing rate limiter config on gateway now: increasing token bucket size from 100 -> 500 and refill from 10r/s -> 100r/s for the short window. Command:```bash
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap rate-limiter --patch 'data:{"bucket_size":"500","refill_rate":"100"}'
```

rebecca: pushed. rolling restarts on gateway nodes to pick up change.

emily: after changes: 429 rate dropped from 14k/min to 2.3k/min; 503s still present but trending down. backend pod logs show backlog timeouts from upstream ingress -> inference runtime queue saturated.

josh: added temporary direct whitelist for enterprise client IDs to skip quota enforcement:```json
{"whitelist_clients": ["acct-111","acct-222","acct-333"]}
``` applied to edge-proxy.

support-bot: Status page updated: "Partial degradation affecting inference streaming in us-east-1. Mitigation actions in progress." https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-09

rebecca: good. now we need to validate that the quota aggregator change is root cause: priya can you diff the config?

priya: diff shows aggregator was treating X-Client-RateLimit as global instead of per-tenant when header absent. fallback math produced overly aggressive global caps. attaching snippet:```patch
- "aggregate_scope": "per-tenant"
+ "aggregate_scope": "global_if_missing_header"
```

emily: that matches the spike pattern: a subset of clients didn't send the header and got grouped -> global cap -> flood of 429s and then gateway timeouts.

josh: next steps: 1) revert aggregator behavior to strict per-tenant (rolling back commit d4f3b2), 2) add unit test to validate header absence handling, 3) create canary gating for quota-service changes on 1% traffic. I'll own rollback/test/canary.

rebecca: assign follow-ups: josh (rollback + tests), priya (deploy gating + docs), emily/support (customer comms + impact metrics). severity: P2. incident duration measured from alert to primary mitigation ~18m.

incident-bot: Incident PD-7890 set to mitigated. Notes: pause deploy + rate-limiter relax + whitelist produced recovery. Timeline saved.

support-bot: Draft email to affected customers prepared and queued.

rebecca: leaving handoff to next oncall @jordan in 10m; i'll remain available on slack for 1hr. thanks team. :heart:
